## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Saint Augustine, United States. It starts at 2045 Florida 16.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Prepare to be mesmerized by the captivating world of marine biology at the St. Augustine Aquarium. Nestled on Rt. 16, a mere hop and skip from I-95, this landlocked aquarium is a slice of oceanic paradise that promises to leave guests spellbound.
>
> Immerse yourself in the wonders of the deep with a plethora of indoor and open-air exhibits that offer a glimpse into the aquatic universe. Guests can embark on a snorkeling adventure in an 80,000-gallon tank that teems with hundreds of Florida reef fish, including the majestic angelfish, blue-lined grunts, and high-hats.
>
> The knowledgeable staff at the St. Augustine Aquarium is passionate about sharing their love for marine biology and invites guests to explore the sea and its inhabitants. Guests can embark on a thrilling adventure to search for seahorses hiding in the seagrass, or touch starfishes, horseshoe crabs, and other invertebrates.
